_doc: Named package sets for `bin/desktop-sandbox --build --profile NAME` (combine with --packages for extras). Every name was checked against Debian bookworm on arm64 and amd64. openjfx is absent on arm64: JavaFX apps must bundle it. A build replaces the image, so a profile lists everything that image needs.
